$comment: Ground truth for its CONFORMING twin: the verdict a human RGAA 4.1.2 auditor gives each of the 106 criteria, established from the official tests (src/data/standards/rgaa.json). verdict is C, NC, NA or manual (undeterminable from this one page). tests/rgaa-golden.test.ts holds the engine to it.

1.3.reason: the photo's alternative describes the team, the image button's names its action

1.4.reason: no image is used as a CAPTCHA or test image
